SparkR / SPARKR-186
Create basic DataFrame Support
Issue Type: Sub-task
Assignee: Unassigned
Components: DataFrame
Created: 29/Jan/15 11:49 AM
Priority: Critical
Reporter: Shivaram Venkataraman

This task will track adding basic data frame support. This includes
1. Creating a SQLContext in SparkR (similar to SQLContext in PySpark)
2. Add ability to read in Parquet, JSON Files using SparkSQL
3. Support passing in SQL queries as strings to operate on DataFrames
